setup_logging_master_process: setup logging for the master process with stdout and optional file handler output
setup_logging_file_output: setup logging to save log messages to a specified file path in append mode
get_logger_by_name: get a named logger instance from the logging hierarchy by its string name
suppress_print_non_master: suppress print output from non-master processes in a multi-process environment
review_setup_logging: review the setup_logging function to understand multi-process logging configuration and handler setup
